text.trigger: A player moves a survivor without burning a Fuel card.
text.vignette: The blizzard thickens until the road is a blur, and shapes drift in it, then more shapes, all walking the way you are. There is no clean exit, only a gamble on slipping through or backing up.

options.push-through: Slip through: the moved survivor rolls exposure 3 more times.
options.turn-back: Back away: the moved survivor returns to where the move began (not a move) and cannot be moved again this turn.
